extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and chrome://extensions. Max 75 characters.

extDescription.message: Hides profanity, accidents, violence and negative sensationalism on news portals and social media.
extDescription.description: Extension description in the Chrome Web Store. Max 132 characters.

appTagline.description: Subtitle under the product name in the popup header.

filterToggleTitle.message: Turn the filter on or off
filterToggleTitle.description: Tooltip of the main on/off switch.

filterToggleLabel.description: Accessible name of the main on/off switch.

stateOn.description: Short label next to the main switch when the filter is on.

stateOff.description: Short label next to the main switch when the filter is off.

statTitle.description: Heading of the counter of hidden items on the current page.

statChecking.description: Shown while the popup queries the current tab.

statOff.description: Shown when the filter is turned off.

statUnreachable.message: The filter does not run on this page, or the page needs to be reloaded.
statUnreachable.description: Shown when the content script does not run on the current page.

statActive.message: Posts and articles collapsed by the filter.
statActive.description: Explains the counter of hidden items.

loadError.description: Shown when settings could not be loaded.

keywordsTitle.description: Heading of the keyword list card.

keywordPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the new keyword input. The examples are Polish keywords on purpose (the filter targets Polish sites).

keywordInputLabel.description: Accessible name of the new keyword input.

keywordHint.message: Enter a word stem to cover all inflected forms (e.g. “tragedi” → tragedia, tragedii). Separate multiple phrases with commas.
keywordHint.description: Help text under the keyword input.

keywordListLabel.description: Accessible name of the list of active keywords.

keywordEmpty.message: The list is empty — nothing will be hidden.
keywordEmpty.description: Shown when the keyword list is empty.

restoreDefaults.description: Link that restores the default keywords.

removeKeywordTitle.description: Tooltip of the × button on a keyword chip.

removeKeywordLabel.description: Accessible name of the × button on a keyword chip.

keywordErrorLength.message: A phrase must be $min$ to $max$ characters long.
keywordErrorLength.description: Validation error: phrase too short or too long.

keywordErrorDuplicate.message: This phrase is already on the list.
keywordErrorDuplicate.description: Validation error: the phrase is already on the list.

keywordAddedOne.description: Confirmation after adding a single phrase.

keywordsAdded_one.description: Confirmation after adding phrases (plural form: one).

keywordsAdded_few.description: Confirmation after adding phrases (plural form: few).

keywordsAdded_many.description: Confirmation after adding phrases (plural form: many).

keywordsAdded_other.description: Confirmation after adding phrases (plural form: other).

keywordsSkipped.description: Appended to the confirmation when some phrases were rejected.

defaultsAllPresent.message: All default phrases are already on the list.
defaultsAllPresent.description: Shown when all default phrases are already on the list.

defaultsRestored_one.message: Restored $count$ phrase from the default list.
defaultsRestored_one.description: Confirmation after restoring default phrases (plural form: one).

defaultsRestored_few.message: Restored $count$ phrases from the default list.
defaultsRestored_few.description: Confirmation after restoring default phrases (plural form: few).

defaultsRestored_many.message: Restored $count$ phrases from the default list.
defaultsRestored_many.description: Confirmation after restoring default phrases (plural form: many).

defaultsRestored_other.message: Restored $count$ phrases from the default list.
defaultsRestored_other.description: Confirmation after restoring default phrases (plural form: other).

engineTitle.description: Heading of the evaluation engine card.

engineKeywordsDesc.message: Always on — also used as a fallback for the AI model.

engineActive.description: Badge showing that an engine is active.

engineAiName.description: Name of the local AI engine.

engineAiDesc.message: Sends text only to your own local server.
engineAiDesc.description: Description of the local AI engine.

engineAiToggleLabel.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the local AI switch.

aiProtocolLabel.description: Label of the AI request format (protocol) picker.

aiProtocol_simple.description: Option of the protocol picker: ParaBene's own simple JSON contract.

aiProtocol_basal.description: Option of the protocol picker: the basal-serve typed-decision API (a product name, normally not translated).

aiProtocolSaved.description: Confirmation after changing the request format.

aiEndpointLabel.description: Label of the endpoint URL input.

aiTest.description: Button that tests the connection to the local model.

aiHint.message: When the model does not respond, ParaBene automatically falls back to keywords.
aiHint.description: Help text under the endpoint input.

aiErrorInvalidUrl.message: Enter a full http(s):// URL, e.g. $example$
aiErrorInvalidUrl.description: Validation error for the endpoint URL.

aiEndpointSaved.description: Confirmation after saving the endpoint URL.

aiTestText.description: Sample text sent to the local model when testing the connection.

aiConnectedWithReason.description: Connection test succeeded and the model returned a reason.

aiConnectionFailed.message: No connection ($error$). Falling back to keywords.
aiConnectionFailed.description: Connection test failed; the placeholder is one of the aiError_* messages.

aiError_noResponse.description: Connection error: the service worker did not answer.

aiError_invalidResponse.description: Connection error: the model returned malformed JSON.

aiError_unreachable.description: Connection error: the server cannot be reached.

aiError_notFound.message: HTTP 404: the server has no route $path$. For basal-serve, pick the “basal-serve” format and enter just the server address, e.g. http://192.168.1.170:8010
aiError_notFound.description: Connection error: the endpoint answered 404 (wrong path or wrong request format).

aiError_unknown.description: Connection error with a raw technical message.

aiModeLabel.description: Label of the picker that sets how keywords and the AI model work together.

aiMode_both.message: Keywords + AI: hide when either matches
aiMode_both.description: Mode option: a keyword match hides at once, other texts are checked by the AI model.

aiMode_ai.message: AI only (keywords only while the server is down)
aiMode_ai.description: Mode option: the AI model decides alone; keywords are used only as a fallback.

aiSensitivityLabel.description: Label of the basal-serve sensitivity picker (hide threshold).

aiSensitivity_high.message: High — hides more, more false positives

aiTopicsLabel.description: Legend of the topic checkboxes; each checkbox uses a category_* message.

aiTopicsEmpty.message: No topics selected — the AI model will not hide anything.
aiTopicsEmpty.description: Warning shown when no topic is selected.

aiScore.description: basal-serve connection test: hide score and the threshold, appended to aiConnected*.

engineImagesName.description: Name of the optional image evaluation engine (basal-omni is a model name).

engineImagesDesc.message: Sends pictures from posts only to your local server running a multimodal model.
engineImagesDesc.description: Description of the image evaluation engine.

engineImagesToggleLabel.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the image evaluation switch.

aiImagesEndpointLabel.message: Address of the basal-serve server with image support
aiImagesEndpointLabel.description: Label of the image server URL input.

aiImagesHint.message: A separate server: basal-serve --model Remek/basal-omni-1.0-mini --mode eager --media on. One picture takes about 2 s, so only posts near the visible part of the page are checked.
aiImagesHint.description: Help text under the image server URL input; the command line is not translated.

aiImagesConnecting.message: Sending a test picture… (the first request after a server start takes about 15 s)
aiImagesConnecting.description: Shown while testing the image server.

aiImagesConnected.message: Connected ✓ Model $model$ judged the test picture in $seconds$ s.
aiImagesConnected.description: Image server test succeeded; aiScore may follow.

aiImagesConnectionFailed.message: No connection to the image server ($error$). Pictures will not be checked.
aiImagesConnectionFailed.description: Image server test failed; the placeholder is one of the aiError_* messages.

aiError_noImageSupport.message: model $model$ does not take images — run basal-serve with a basal-omni model and --media on
aiError_noImageSupport.description: Connection error: the server's model has no image support.

aiError_imagesNotFound.message: HTTP 404: the server does not know the path $path$. Enter just the address of the basal-serve server running a basal-omni model, e.g. http://192.168.1.170:8011
aiError_imagesNotFound.description: Image server error: the address answered 404 (wrong path).

languageLabel.description: Label of the UI language picker.

barText.description: Text of the bar that replaces hidden content on web pages.

barReason.description: Reason for hiding, shown in the bar.

barReasonAi.description: Reason for hiding given by the local AI model, shown in the bar.

barReasonAiImage.description: Reason for hiding given by the AI model after judging a picture of the content, shown in the bar.

barReveal.description: Button in the bar that reveals hidden content.

reasonUnknown.description: Fallback reason when none is available.

reasonAiDefault.description: Reason used when the AI model hides content without giving a reason.

category_profanity.description: Category name shown instead of the matched profane word.

category_accident.description: Category name: the AI model found an accident, disaster or fire.

category_violence.description: Category name: the AI model found violence, crime, an attack or war.

category_death.description: Category name: the AI model found death, illness or a personal tragedy.

category_politics.description: Category name: the AI model found politics, politicians or a political dispute.

category_clickbait.description: Category name: the AI model found sensationalism or a shocking (clickbait) headline.

sourceKeyword.description: Label of the number of items hidden by keywords on the current page (the number follows).

sourceAi.description: Label of the number of items hidden by the local AI model on the current page (the number follows).

logTitle.description: Heading of the card with the log of hidden content.

logToggleName.description: Name of the switch that turns the log of hidden content on.

logDesc.message: Text, page address and reason (keywords or AI) — kept locally only, downloadable as a file for analysis.
logDesc.description: Explains what the log of hidden content records.

logOff.description: Shown when the log is off and empty.

logEmpty.message: No entries yet — hidden content will be recorded while you browse.
logEmpty.description: Shown when the log is on but empty.

logDownload.description: Button that downloads the log as a JSON Lines file.

logClear.description: Link that deletes all log entries.

logClearConfirm.description: Shown on the clear link after the first click; a second click deletes the log.

logSummary.description: Summary of the log: entries hidden by keywords, by the AI model, and how many the user revealed with 'Show anyway'.
